version: 1.3.13
cache: true
interface:
  customWelcome: "Local models, private infrastructure."
  autoSubmitFromUrl: false
  modelSelect: true
  parameters: true
  contextUsage: true
  presets: true
  mcpServers:
    use: true
    create: true
    share: false
    public: false
  prompts:
    use: true
    create: true
    share: false
    public: false
  bookmarks: true
  multiConvo: true
  skills:
    use: true
    create: true
    share: false
    public: false
  temporaryChat: true
  temporaryChatRetention: 24
  runCode: false
  defaultPinnedTools:
    - artifacts
    - mcp
  agents:
    use: true
    create: true
    share: false
    public: false
  marketplace:
    use: false
registration:
  socialLogins:
    - openid
endpoints:
  agents:
    allowedProviders:
      - Local
    capabilities:
      - deferred_tools
      - artifacts
      - subagents
      - actions
      - context
      - skills
      - tools
      - chain
    recursionLimit: 20
    maxRecursionLimit: 30
    titleTiming: final
  custom:
    - name: Local
      apiKey: "${LLAMA_SWAP_API_KEY}"
      baseURL: "${LLAMA_SWAP_BASE_URL}"
      models:
        default:
          - qwen3.6
        fetch: true
      titleConvo: true
      titleTiming: final
      titleModel: current_model
      summarize: false
      modelDisplayLabel: Local
